notes: pig CLI entrypoint; capability stub returns a structured NotImplementedError with no network, persistence or success side effects (issue #17).
pig-ai CLI entrypoint; capability stub returns a structured NotImplementedError with no network, persistence or success side effects (issue #17).
pig-ai login CLI and provider auth surface (API key, OAuth, ambient auth). The 40-provider compatibility matrix and login flows are M11; this entry anchors the command contract.

pig command/flag surface: global flags (--session/--continue/--resume/--fork/--session-id/--model/--provider/--mode/--print/--thinking/--tools/--no-*), the auth subcommand and its options, and exit codes. Individual exported parsing symbols are enumerated in parity/surface/symbols.jsonl; this entry is the contract-level anchor for the CLI grammar and its incompatible-flag/exit-code behaviour.
Process exit-code contract: auth check maps ready=0, not_ready=1, error=2; conflicting flags and unknown options exit 1. Verified per-case against the fixed baseline as CLI behaviour lands.

deviation.reason: pig and pig-ai share the default ~/.pig/agent/auth.json with 0600 permissions and locking; upstream pi-ai's ./auth.json behaviour is a registered accepted deviation with its own Parity Case (docs/roadmap.md state-and-credential boundary).

notes: auth.json credential store format: per-provider credentials, read-only vs read-write stores, 0600 permission and lock invariants.

models.json format: immutable, credential-blind model snapshot used by the model runtime. The full provider/model catalog capture is tracked separately (parity/baseline/snapshot.manifest.json, pending-capture).
Global and project settings format and precedence, gated behind minimal Project Trust. Pig uses .pig/~/.pig/PIG_* only and never implicitly reads .pi/PI_* (docs/roadmap.md).

On-disk layout migrations: migrateAuthToAuthJson, migrateSessionsFromAgentRoot, commands->prompts, keybindings config and tools->bin. Exchanged only when an existing operation explicitly receives the path; never auto-migrated.
CBOR encoder/decoder and options backing the protocol codec; deterministic encoding is a wire-compatibility contract verified against the fixed baseline.

Length-prefixed CBOR frame codec: 4-byte unsigned big-endian length prefix (encodeFrame/assertCompleteFrame/FrameDecoder). Issue #22's Pi Oracle (parity/oracle/run.mjs) captured encodeFrame output for the canonical ClientHello and internal/oracle replays the committed fixture (parity/oracle/fixtures/protocol-frame.json) offline, independently re-deriving the header via encoding/binary.BigEndian — a genuine cross-implementation parity check backing this verified status. The exported symbols are enumerated in parity/surface/symbols.jsonl.
Remote protocol version (PROTOCOL_VERSION=1) and isSupportedProtocolVersion gate. The exported symbols are enumerated in parity/surface/symbols.jsonl; this anchors the wire-compatibility contract.

JSONL RPC command union (prompt/steer/follow_up/abort/compact/fork/clone/switch_session/new_session/set_model/cycle_model/get_* and extension_ui_request/response, ~35 discriminated variants) plus RpcResponse success/error shape. Individual variants are enumerated in parity/surface/symbols.jsonl.
Newline-delimited JSON transport framing for RPC mode: one JSON value per line, request/response correlation and stream events.

Session entry migrations v1->v2->v3 (migrateV1ToV2/migrateV2ToV3/migrateToCurrentVersion). Data migrations only; no implicit trust or credential migration and no general migration CLI (docs/roadmap.md).
Coding Agent session persistence: JSONL row structure at CURRENT_SESSION_VERSION=3, header, resume and fork semantics.
AgentHarness v4 memory/JSONL session structure (version:4), reducer and compaction substrate; faithfully reproduced at M8 including upstream's unimplemented operations.

deferred.reason: Extension runtime and ABI are deferred; M7 first compares Go plugin, WASM, sidecar and script options and produces a new ADR before any extension host is implemented.

notes: docs/adr/0009 and docs/specs/extensions.md: inventory the Extension Surface only; do not freeze a loading or communication ABI before M7.

deferred.reason: Pig V1 does not port server, evals or session-backends and does not provide a Pig Server; the fixed upstream server package is used only as a test host and fake server for protocol/client interop.

notes: See docs/design/architecture.md and docs/adr/0003; protocol and client still implement remote sessions and verify interop against the fixed upstream server package.
